process.objective: Implement the Deep Research benchmark recommendations as a final Benchmark V1 architecture freeze before real owner pilot/calibration data is collected.

decisions.change: Frozen the Benchmark V1 construct as OWNER_PRODUCT_FIT: blind owner preference between two Vietnamese historical-podcast outputs performing the same editorial function, with Truth audited independently.
decisions.declared_reason: Deep Research found that the current project needs a personalized product-fit signal rather than AI quality, FoC similarity, or general-audience preference.
basis: Deep Research report supplied by product owner on 2026-09-06
decisions.expected_effect: Prevent evaluator/rubric scores from silently redefining the product target.

decisions.change: Separated first-pass holistic pairwise preference from post-vote diagnostics and added BOTH_FAIL plus confidence and an explicit freeze boundary.
decisions.declared_reason: The owner must be able to reject both variants and must choose before taxonomy/reference priming. Legacy six-dimension scoring cannot override holistic product preference.
basis: Deep Research sections on pairwise preference, BOTH_FAIL, and taxonomy-after-vote
decisions.expected_effect: Reduce Goodhart pressure from fixed rubric dimensions and preserve cases where both outputs are unacceptable.

decisions.change: Created a separate failure-signature contract with SPAN/MULTI_SPAN/UNIT_GLOBAL scope, one primary family, optional UNRESOLVED state, contributes_to, and root_cause constrained to null.
decisions.declared_reason: Output diagnosis must be a clean root node for future white-box tracing and must not smuggle upstream blame into the benchmark.
decisions.expected_effect: Localize or characterize failures without pretending to know which agent/module caused them.

decisions.change: Replaced the legacy Product defect vocabulary with a frozen six-family minimal taxonomy: NARRATIVE_FUNCTION, EXPOSITION_LOAD, SPOKEN_COMPREHENSION, GROUNDING_SPECIFICITY, VOICE_STANCE, REDUNDANCY.
decisions.declared_reason: Deep Research showed that payoff/progression/connection and essay tendency were being split or double-counted in ways that could obscure the actual observable defect.
basis: Deep Research proposed minimal taxonomy and anti-double-counting rules
decisions.expected_effect: Make diagnostics smaller, more orthogonal, and more useful for later trace isolation.

decisions.change: Introduced evaluation-unit metadata and three granularities: FUNCTION_CLIP, SECTION_SENTINEL, EPISODE_SENTINEL.
decisions.declared_reason: A clip-only benchmark can be gamed locally while damaging section/episode flow; evaluation must be tied to editorial function rather than arbitrary word counts.
basis: Deep Research evaluation-unit and sentinel recommendation
decisions.expected_effect: Support slice-based evaluation and future macro Goodhart checks without forcing all content into one primitive.

decisions.change: Strengthened Truth records with claim_type, verifiability, source_relation, materiality, release_blocker, implied-premise and causal claim types.
decisions.declared_reason: Previous Truth review failed on rhetorical hidden premises and causal overreach because quote presence and NONFACTUAL labels were too coarse.
decisions.expected_effect: Make Truth failures semantically auditable while keeping Product preference observable even when release is blocked.

decisions.change: Created a separate spoken-observation lane for TEXT_PREDICTION, AUDIO_OBSERVATION, and LISTENER_REPORT.
decisions.declared_reason: Text-only review cannot validly certify prosody or actual listener comprehension; modality must bound the claims allowed.
decisions.expected_effect: Prevent text heuristics from masquerading as listening evidence and leave a clean path for later audio/listener validation.

decisions.change: Demoted every historical P01 artifact in the public/shared repo to DEV, converted the three existing owner pairs to PILOT, and replaced public HOLDOUT semantics with a private/restricted SEQUESTERED manifest shell.
decisions.declared_reason: Anything repeatedly exposed during P01/harness tuning is contaminated for blind benchmark validity. A public repository cannot hold a genuine sequestered payload and labels.
decisions.expected_effect: Stop historical P01 from being reused as false out-of-sample evidence and make refreshed sequestered evidence mandatory after tuning exposure.

decisions.change: Formalized LLM judge state as SHADOW_ONLY with no optimization authority until owner agreement, position/duplicate/span/uncertainty and transfer gates are validated out of sample under pre-registered tolerances.
decisions.declared_reason: Deep Research documented multiple LLM judge biases and rejected agent agreement as gold.
basis: Deep Research LLM judge reliability recommendation
decisions.expected_effect: Allow evaluator experimentation without letting an unvalidated proxy steer the writing loop.

decisions.change: Kept FoC strictly post-vote/function-matched, prohibited style similarity scoring, and removed any Bradley-Terry/Elo/global-quality-score requirement from V1.
decisions.declared_reason: Small-sample latent rankings would create false precision, and reference visibility during primary preference can anchor the evaluator toward surface similarity.
basis: Deep Research aggregation and reference-bias recommendations
decisions.expected_effect: Preserve raw owner outcomes and functional target-gap evidence without collapsing distinct constructs into one score.

implementation_steps.action: Created an Iteration 04 work order and isolated implementation on a V1-freeze sub-branch.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Deep Research recommendations were converted into bounded implementation requirements before edits.

implementation_steps.action: Created separate schemas for evaluation unit, first-pass preference, failure signature, spoken evidence, and judge reliability; strengthened Truth and Target-gap schemas.
implementation_steps.observed_result: The former monolithic output schema is deprecated; each measurement surface now has a bounded responsibility.

implementation_steps.action: Froze the six-family Product taxonomy and an explicit pilot evaluation unit.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Failure diagnostics now support one primary family, macro scope, unresolved classification, and later trace linkage.

implementation_steps.action: Reclassified all public historical P01 samples as DEV and changed current owner pairs from calibration evidence to pilot-only inputs.
implementation_steps.observed_result: No public P01 sample is represented as blind holdout/sequestered evidence.

implementation_steps.action: Added a public sequestered manifest shell and initialized an unvalidated shadow-judge state.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Private benchmark evidence has an explicit lifecycle without leaking payload/labels into the public repo; LLM judge has no optimization authority.

implementation_steps.action: Upgraded all three owner packets to pilot-first preference protocol with BOTH_FAIL, confidence, explicit freeze, and post-vote optional diagnostics.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Owner can reject both outputs and is not shown taxonomy/reference material before the first-pass vote.

implementation_steps.action: Rewrote the Phase 1 contract, trial protocol, active entrypoint, Worker loop, Worker iteration schema, and structural verifier around Benchmark V1.3.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Active documentation and verifier no longer route work through the legacy six-dimension/holdout architecture.

validations.command: Static GitHub connector inspection of changed schemas/data/docs against Iteration 04 work order
validations.observed_result: Confirmed implementation of preference-first separation, BOTH_FAIL/confidence, six-family taxonomy, evaluation-unit granularity, Truth semantic fields, spoken lane, DEV-only P01 history, sequestered shell, SHADOW_ONLY judge, and post-vote FoC boundary.
Execution environment could not resolve github.com, so repository checkout failed before the verifier could run. No synthetic PASS was recorded.

The three historical owner packets remain under the existing calibration/owner-packets directory for provenance compatibility, but their role/state is explicitly PILOT_ONLY_NOT_CALIBRATION_EVIDENCE.
No fresh calibration pairs or private sequestered payload were fabricated during architecture implementation.

Create a fresh calibration corpus across multiple editorial functions after pilot protocol stability is confirmed.

deliverables.role: public metadata shell for private/restricted validation evidence
pilot owner state and future calibration metrics

measurement_design.primary_evaluation: Blind first-pass owner A|B|TIE|BOTH_FAIL|UNCERTAIN preference with confidence, frozen before diagnostics/reference material.
measurement_design.diagnostic_method: Post-vote failure signatures using one primary family from a six-family taxonomy, SPAN/MULTI_SPAN/UNIT_GLOBAL scope, optional UNRESOLVED state, and root_cause=null.
measurement_design.truth_method: Independent claim-level audit with claim type, verifiability, source relation, materiality, and release blocker; Product preference still runs even if Truth blocks release.
measurement_design.spoken_method: Separate TEXT_PREDICTION, AUDIO_OBSERVATION, and LISTENER_REPORT evidence modes so text-only judgments cannot certify listening outcomes.
measurement_design.target_gap_method: FoC/reference appears only after preference freeze, is matched by editorial function, cannot change the vote, and cannot use style similarity as a score.

dataset_partitions.dev: All historical P01 material in the public/shared repository, including the former calibration candidates and former holdout.
dataset_partitions.pilot: Three historical P01 A/B packets used only to test protocol/interface behavior; not validity evidence.
dataset_partitions.calibration: Not yet populated; must be fresh owner-labelled pairs collected after pilot protocol stability.
dataset_partitions.sequestered: Private/restricted payload not yet created; public repository contains only a metadata shell.
dataset_partitions.refreshed_sequestered: Required after any previous sequestered set is opened and used for tuning.

output.craft_corpus_coverage: Unchanged: 8 transcript-only FoC excerpts across 2 episodes/functions; hidden from primary preference and used only post-vote.

verifier_result.observed_result: Verifier implementation was updated, but a real checkout execution could not run because the container could not resolve github.com. Static connector review passed; no runtime PASS is claimed.

known_limitations: Architecture is frozen for pilot, but the three current pilot pairs are exposed historical DEV material.
Fresh calibration corpus has not been collected.
No LLM judge has been selected or validated; current state is SHADOW_ONLY and ineligible for optimization.
No private/restricted sequestered payload or labels exist yet.
No topic-transfer evidence exists outside historical P01 material.
Audio/listener validation has not been run.
Structural verifier has not yet executed in a full repository checkout/CI environment.
output.summary: Deep Research recommendations are encoded as Benchmark V1.3 architecture. Primary preference is now holistic and preference-first; diagnostics, Truth, Spoken, Target Gap, and judge reliability are separate artifacts; all public historical P01 evidence is DEV; sequestered evidence is explicitly private/restricted; LLM judges have no optimization authority. The next valid step is owner protocol pilot, not another rubric redesign or Writer round.
